# Rendered by ranch-radio from hosts/linux-laptop.json. Edit that file, then `ranch-radio install`.

[Unit]
Description=Radio Remote for the QRP Labs QMX (USB)
After=network-online.target sound.target pipewire.service wireplumber.service
Wants=pipewire.service wireplumber.service
BindsTo=dev-qmx.device
After=dev-qmx.device
Wants=qmx-remote.socket
After=qmx-remote.socket

[Service]
ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/mkdir -p %h/.local/state/radio-remote/ardop/qmx
ExecStartPre=-/bin/sh -c 'for i in $$(seq 40); do pactl get-sink-volume alsa_output.usb-QRP_Labs_QMX_Transceiver-02.analog-stereo >/dev/null 2>&1 && pactl get-source-volume alsa_input.usb-QRP_Labs_QMX_Transceiver-02.analog-stereo >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 0.5; done; echo sound card not in PipeWire after 20 s >&2'
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 %h/ranch-radio/server.py --rig qmx --port /dev/qmx --audio-device pipewire:alsa_input.usb-QRP_Labs_QMX_Transceiver-02.analog-stereo,alsa_output.usb-QRP_Labs_QMX_Transceiver-02.analog-stereo --tx-timeout 60 --host 127.0.0.1 --listen 7302 --rigctl-host 0.0.0.0 --rigctl-port 4534 --winlink-rigctl-port 4538 --winlink-ardop-log %h/.local/state/radio-remote/ardop/qmx --winlink-mode USB
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
NotifyAccess=main
FileDescriptorStoreMax=16
FileDescriptorStorePreserve=restart
RuntimeDirectory=qmx-remote
RuntimeDirectoryPreserve=restart
TimeoutStopSec=10

[Install]
WantedBy=dev-qmx.device

[Socket]

[Install]
WantedBy=dev-qmx.device
